# Luna-12J - Temporal-Associative Structural Learning Efficacy and Causal Verification

Read `workflow/ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACT.md`,
`workflow/ARCHITECTURE_CHANGELOG.md`, `workflow/docs/luna/LUNA_WORKFLOW.md`,
`workflow/docs/architecture/ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA.md`,
`workflow/docs/luna/AGENT_HANDOFF_TEMPLATE.md`,
`workflow/docs/luna/LUNA_12I_TEMPORAL_ASSOCIATIVE_STRUCTURAL_GROWTH.md`,
`workflow/docs/luna/LUNA_12J_TEMPORAL_ASSOCIATIVE_EFFICACY.md`, and the
Luna-12I handoff before editing. Record the exact baseline revision and
preserve unrelated worktree changes.

## Authorization and ownership

Luna-12J is a separately dispatched `EXPERIMENT` and `VERIFICATION` milestone.
Creating this scaffold does not execute it. Own experiment fixtures, controlled
runner options, measurement hooks, analysis, focused tests and the Luna-12J
handoff. Use the existing persistent bounded topology, structural mutation
authority and Luna-12E routed computation. Do not create a second topology.

Minimal production changes are allowed only when a demonstrated defect blocks
measurement and the smallest fix is explicitly within the dispatch. Otherwise
return `BLOCKED` to Luna-0 rather than changing the Luna-12I policy.

## Hypothesis, controls and boundaries

Test whether repeated local temporal succession produces useful convergent or
shortened causal structure and measurable downstream benefit beyond legal
random or pre-12I growth. Compare fixed topology, the existing structural
policy, random legal growth and Luna-12I growth under matched seeds, budgets,
delays, events, mutation attempts, candidate/state capacity, epochs and resets.
Add shuffled/reversed/destroyed timing controls where practical. Retain all
declared seeds and negative results.

Labels, future events, global topology statistics, evaluation metrics, wall
clock and unrestricted trainer state are forbidden from canonical neural or
structural decisions. Preserve A01-A04, A06-A11, A14 and A15, including local
energy/utility and delayed credit semantics. All queues, histories, candidates,
edges, paths, mutations and analysis buffers are finite.

## Required evidence

Use a deterministic accepted temporal benchmark, or the smallest synthetic
temporal fixture needed if the benchmark cannot distinguish the effect. Verify
that topology changes affect actual event routing and downstream state/output.
Measure task/class separation, prediction/error, events, activations,
resource/energy proxy and units, edge and fan-in/out utilization, additions,
removals, rejections, motifs, delays, path shortening, replacement, churn,
stabilization and determinism. Directly investigate whether ordinary growth
consumes capacity before useful convergence forms.

Perform a causal intervention where practical: remove/freeze/replace a learned
edge or replay identical events before and after intervention. Correlation
between topology and behavior is not causal evidence.

## Validation and gate

Focused tests must cover equal bounds, label/future isolation, same-seed
replay, real topology change, routed computational effect and removal of a
learned causal contribution. Run the focused 12J tests, 12I and 12H tests,
relevant 12E routing tests, affected structural-plasticity and readout/classifier
regressions, full pytest, compile/static checks, workspace diagnostics and
`git diff --check`. Mark every check passed, failed, not run or not applicable.

Return one of `supported`, `partially supported`, `not supported`,
`inconclusive` or `blocked`, and one gate of PASS, PASS WITH FOLLOW-UP,
INCONCLUSIVE, NOT SUPPORTED or BLOCKED. Separate `OBSERVED`, `INFERRED` and
`HYPOTHESIZED` evidence. Even PASS returns to Luna-0 for a separate architecture
review; it does not amend A14 or authorize Luna-12K or any later Luna.
